review: Agent visual inspection, not author acceptance

family_notes.human: Grounded adult proportions and plain garments. Male facial hair and female shoulder-length hair are examples only; the four faces and four hairstyles per sex remain separate work.
family_notes.goblin: Natural tan skin and pointed ears preserve the owned references. Review whether the body silhouette and ear-to-head proportions distinguish this family enough from humans.
family_notes.caelith: Green skin with white hair is one example of independent skin/hair choices. Version 1 shortened the ears; version 2 restores the longer pointed silhouette. Skin RGB and all six hair colors remain required.
family_notes.wolf: Gray/brown/cream fur and a full animal muzzle. Review the neck ruff and transition into the collar, head scale and male/female body distinction.
family_notes.bear: Brown fur, round ears and a broad animal muzzle. The clothed body remains close to the common humanoid base; review whether the shoulder/torso mass is sufficient for the intended bear form.
family_notes.puma: Unspotted tawny coat and a feline muzzle, using the corrected puma_head_v2 reference. Review head scale, muzzle depth and collar transition.
family_notes.jaguar: Golden coat, dark rosettes and a broad feline muzzle. Review jaguar identity, head scale and whether rosettes remain readable at gameplay distance.

observed_correction: Caelith v1 ears were shorter than owned references; retained v2 enlarges the ear silhouette.
limitation: All views are generated concept artwork. No mesh, anatomy under clothing, palette masking or native modular assembly was tested.
